notes.title: 《Cosmic High Schooler》Demo at Steam Fest: Now with English Text!
notes.content:
《Cosmic High Schooler》 Demo Joins the Steam New Festival! This Demo comes with English text for global players!
No matter where you're from, you can now immerse yourself in this fantastical campus story, explore the mysteries of the cosmos and fantasy.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310940/__Cosmic_High_Schooler/

About Demo Update:
Added English Text: To enhance the gaming experience for players worldwide, we've specially included English text support, allowing more players to embark on this youthful fantasy journey set in a Chinese campus!

We welcome any feedback or suggestions regarding the English text. Please feel free to email us!
Email address :cosmic_train@ 163.com


If you enjoy the game, please add it to your wishlist to receive the latest updates promptly!
Player Discussion QQGroup: 628699031
Game Development: 日冕鹰
Game Publisher: Cosmic Train (COSMIC TRAIN)

notes.title: 《神明高中生》·上海AnimeMarket02参展确认！
notes.content:
《神明高中生》将在本周12.14~15日在上海国际会展中心举办的AnimeMarket02与大家线下见面！

展会现场将可以体验到《神明高中生》Demo的试玩~
现场试玩还将赠送主角徽章，更有精美明信片！欢迎各位前来游玩！

添加了愿望单的小伙伴凭截图还可以额外领取明信片一张
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310940/

时间：12月14~12月15日
展位：展商区007
期待与大家的见面~
